_about: Display-name overlay applied by scripts/buildCanonicalTcgData.mjs on top of canonical chain names when regenerating generatedTcgCards.json. These are the diversified in-game names (2026-06-08 pass, commit 7e406c0) that previously lived ONLY as post-hoc edits inside the generated file - regenerating would have silently wiped them. Director ruling 2026-06-10 (teardown sec 8): chain names win in-game in P4; this file then becomes the archive of the diversified set. Do not hand-edit generatedTcgCards.json - edit this overlay.
